subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement:

All keys are locks. Some locks are tools. No tool is a weapon.

Conclusions:

I. Some keys are not weapons.

II. All tools are locks.
solution:
Given Statements:

All keys are locks.

Some locks are tools.

No tool is a weapon.

From statements: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b7dc2bc8c3fb8678d428f13f24e483b88d67db474081f98f6096e6a0ab71044.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some keys are not weapons → False (no direct link between keys and tools/weapons)

II. All tools are locks → False (only some locks are tools, not all tools are locks)

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
